preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(grid[0]) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: All rows in the grid have the same length (m).

preconditions.expression: all(cell in {'X', 'O'} for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'X' or 'O'.
The grid is non-empty (n ≥ 1 and m ≥ 1).

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[i][j] == 'X' and not any(grid[x][y] == 'X' and (x < i or (x == i and y < j)) for x in range(len(grid)) for y in range(len(grid[0])) if (abs(x - i) + abs(y - j) == 1)))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the number of connected 'X' shapes, where each shape is a maximal set of adjacent 'X's (horizontally or vertically).
